channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Haddad chama Flávio de 'Bolsonarinho' e contesta discurso antissistema de senador
item.description: Haddad criticized Flávio Bolsonaro, calling him 'Bolsonarinho' and stating that the Bolsonaro family presents itself as anti-system but has implemented the worst policies in the country for 30 years. He also stressed that Lula's re-election is an imperative for the PT and for Brazil.

item.title: Bolsonaros fazem pior política da história do país, diz Haddad
item.description: Former Finance Minister Fernando Haddad (PT) accused the Bolsonaro family of implementing the worst policies in Brazil's history over 30 years, despite posing as anti-system. He stated that the PT cannot allow a setback in the 2026 elections and that Lula will run against Flávio Bolsonaro, whom he referred to as 'Bolsonarinho'. Haddad positioned the PT as the antidote to chaos and announced the approval of the party's new manifesto at the 8th National Congress in Brasília.

item.title: Haddad diz que 80 anos de Lula são “ativo” eleitoral do PT
item.description: Fernando Haddad stated that Lula's 80 years are an electoral 'asset' for the PT, emphasizing his 50 years of struggle and unwavering commitment to principles. He described Lula's re-election as an 'imperative for the future', arguing that the previous government destroyed the Brazilian state and presenting the candidacy as an antidote to chaos. Haddad also addressed Lula's health, noting recent medical procedures and efforts to project vitality to avoid the 'Joe Biden effect'.

item.title: Com críticas a Trump e foco em reeleição de Lula, PT aprova manifesto
item.description: The PT approved its 2026-2027 manifesto at the 8th National Congress, focusing on Lula’s re-election and building a broad coalition against rent-seeking hegemony, citing the global rise of the far-right, especially in the U.S. under Trump. The document stresses Brazil’s strategic importance internationally and proposes internal reforms, such as term limits and gender quotas, to renew the party and strengthen the new working class.

item.title: Zema volta a comprar briga com Mendes e Moraes, em novo vídeo que critica STF; Assista
item.description: Romeu Zema released a new video in his 'Os intocáveis' series, criticizing Supreme Court ministers Gilmar Mendes and Alexandre de Moraes through AI-generated puppets that satirize judicial decisions and alleged conflicts of interest, including the wife of Moraes' contract with the Master Bank. The video accuses the STF of censorship and claims that such attacks boost Zema's popularity as an anti-system presidential candidate in the 2026 elections.

item.title: PT aprova manifesto com aceno ao centro e crítica a Trump
item.description: The PT approved a manifesto at its 8th National Congress aiming to balance its left-wing identity with centrist appeal to support Lula’s 2026 re-election. The document outlines seven structural reforms, including agrarian and communication reforms, and cites economic achievements like controlled inflation and 2.8% annual growth. References to democratic socialism were strengthened and linked to reforms, though the tone remains conciliatory and coalition-oriented.

item.title: Lula gasta R$ 1,5 milhão com posts pelo fim da escala 6 X 1
item.description: The Lula government spent R$1.5 million in 2026 to boost social media posts advocating for the end of the 6x1 work schedule, with R$881,000 invested between April 15–18 after presenting the proposal to Congress. The boosts targeted users aged 18–44 in key electoral states such as São Paulo, Bahia, and Rio de Janeiro, aiming to pressure lawmakers ahead of the CCJ vote in the Chamber of Deputies, which approved the admissibility of reducing the workweek.

item.title: Serra Verde vira tema de “soberania”, mesmo sendo estrangeira
item.description: Psol deputies filed a representation with the PGR claiming that the sale of Serra Verde mineradora to USA Rare Earth (U.S.) threatens national sovereignty by involving strategic rare earth resources, despite the company never having been Brazilian. They argue that transferring control over critical inputs for defense and technology may increase external dependence and hinder the development of a high-value domestic industry, requesting the annulment of the deal and investigation into possible constitutional overreach by former Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado.

item.title: PT aprova documento que propõe 'mecanismos de autocorreção' do Judiciário e mudança na execução de emendas
item.description: The Workers' Party approved a political manifesto at its 8th National Congress, advocating for judicial reform with 'self-correction mechanisms', changes in the execution of parliamentary amendments, tax reform (including income tax exemption for those earning up to R$ 5,000), and administrative reform to reconstruct the Brazilian state. The document emphasizes Lula's re-election as decisive for Brazil's future and the international democratic field, calling for permanent organization and hegemony struggle in social bases. Despite the absence of Lula and presence of figures like Fernando Haddad and Camilo Santana, the manifesto does not propose financial system reform, even amid the Master Case scandal.

item.title: Em congresso, PT aprova manifesto que pede reforma do Judiciário
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) approved, at its 8th National Congress in Brasília, a manifesto calling for judicial reform as part of a set of 'structural' reforms to strengthen democracy and the rule of law. Titled 'Building the Future: PT's Manifesto to Keep Transforming the Country,' the document advocates for democratizing the judiciary, creating self-correction mechanisms, and aligns with the party's ongoing program review. While discussions on the party program and statutory revisions were postponed to 2027, the congress focused on electoral strategies for Lula's 2026 re-election bid, with leaders stressing that judicial reform is essential to unblock the democratic-popular project.

item.title: Sem Lula, PT aprova manifesto para 2026 com foco em reeleição do presidente
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) approved its manifesto 'Building the Future' for the 2026 elections, establishing the re-election of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva as the central axis of the party's strategy. The document highlights positive indicators from Lula's third term, including income growth, poverty reduction, expansion of full-time education, and increased health budget, and proposes eight structural reforms, including tax, political, technological, judicial, administrative, and agrarian reforms. Lula did not attend the PT National Congress in Brasília due to recovery from medical procedures in São Paulo, with a return expected later this Sunday.

item.title: Tarcísio lidera disputa ao governo de SP com 48,2%
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas leads the race for governor of São Paulo with 48.2% of voting intentions, followed by Fernando Haddad at 32.3%. In a potential runoff, Tarcísio would win with 54.2% against Haddad’s 34.6%. The governor also has the highest approval (68.2%) and lowest rejection (22.2%), while Haddad has the highest rejection at 45.6%.

item.title: Os recados que Lula e Flávio mandaram ao eleitorado ao expressarem solidariedade a Donald Trump
item.description: President Lula and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro expressed solidarity with Donald Trump after an assassination attempt, using the moment to reaffirm their commitment to democracy and condemn political violence. Lula tied the gesture to his strategy to regain popularity, referencing the Alexandre Ramagem case and the expulsion of a U.S. agent as part of the ongoing tension with the U.S. administration. Flávio used religious language and indirectly referenced the 2018 stabbing of his father, Jair Bolsonaro, appealing for divine protection against political violence.

item.title: Lula condena a 'violência política' após disparos em jantar de correspondentes com Trump nos EUA
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva condemned the gunfire incident that occurred during a correspondents' dinner in the United States, where former President Donald Trump was present, labeling it an act of political violence. He stated that such actions affront democratic values and emphasized the importance of respecting dialogue and peace in public life.

item.title: Brasileira Solange Farkas presidirá júri da Bienal de Veneza
item.description: Brazilian curator Solange Farkas will preside over the all-female international jury of the 61st Venice Art Biennale, running from May 9 to November 22, 2026, under the theme 'In Minor Keys'. The jury will award Golden and Silver Lions for national and international participations, plus special mentions. Brazilian artists Ayrson Heráclito and Eustaquio Neves are among the 111 selected participants in the international exhibition.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro promete mais mulheres e menos militares no governo
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL's pre-candidate for President, pledged to increase women's representation in government and reduce military influence in key federal positions to appeal to female voters in the 2026 election. He aims to distinguish himself from his father, Jair Bolsonaro, and his main rival, Lula, by projecting a moderate, family-oriented image, including the potential selection of a female running mate, with Priscila Costa and Tereza Cristina among the names under consideration.

item.title: O mentor da proposta do código de ética sugerido pelo PT ao STF
item.description: José Dirceu, former Chief of Staff convicted in the mensalão and petrolão cases (with sentences later annulled), is the mentor behind the PT's proposal for an ethics code at the STF, advocating for judicial self-reform to counter the political use of justice. The initiative emerges amid declining STF popularity and includes measures such as challenging corporate privileges, establishing ethics codes, and strengthening internal accountability mechanisms in higher courts.

item.title: As reações de líderes mundiais ao ataque em jantar com Trump nos EUA
item.description: World leaders, including Lula, Macron, Sheinbaum, and von der Leyen, expressed solidarity with President Donald Trump after a shooting attack during a White House correspondents' dinner, condemning political violence as an affront to democratic values. President Lula emphasized that political violence undermines democracy, while other leaders stressed the importance of security and respect for democratic institutions. The attack, which left Trump and others unharmed, triggered an international wave of condemnation.

item.title: PT, PV e PCdoB pedem ao TSE suspensão de 'Dona Maria', personagem de IA
item.description: PT, PV, and PCdoB have requested the TSE to suspend the social media profiles of 'Dona Maria', an AI-generated character used to attack President Lula, according to the Brazil of Hope Federation. The parties claim the initiative constitutes disinformation and abuse of economic power on social media. The request aims to protect the integrity of electoral debate.

item.title: Reforma tributária também é campo minado para Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticizes the ongoing tax reform, but his stance reveals a contradiction, as similar proposals were put forward by his father, Jair Bolsonaro, during his presidency. This inconsistency exposes a tension between his opposition rhetoric and his family’s tax policy legacy. The article highlights how tax reform has become a political minefield for the PL pre-candidate.

item.title: Lula repudia ataque a tiros ocorrido em evento com Donald Trump
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva strongly condemned the shooting attack against U.S. President Donald Trump during a dinner with journalists in Washington, expressing solidarity with Trump, First Lady Melania Trump, and attendees. The incident occurred on Saturday night, leading to the arrest of a suspect described by Trump as a 'lone wolf,' while the U.S. Secret Service has not released further details about the perpetrator.

item.title: DF lidera em transparência sobre remuneração de funcionários públicos
item.description: The Federal District ranked first in Brazil’s national transparency index for public servant remunerations, scoring 0.89 in a study released by Transparência Brasil on April 22, 2026. It surpassed states such as Pernambuco, Espírito Santo, and Minas Gerais, excelling in data accessibility and detail via its Transparency Portal, where remuneration searches account for 70% of web traffic and 88% on mobile.

item.title: Lula manifesta solidariedade a Trump: ‘Afronta aos valores democráticos’
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva expressed solidarity with Donald Trump following an attack during a White House correspondents' dinner, vehemently condemning political violence as an affront to democratic values. Lula stated that no one has the right to attack someone due to political disagreement and reiterated Brazil’s support for multilateralism and fair trade relations. This marks the second attack against Trump during his term, the first occurring in 2024 at a rally.

item.title: Lula diz que “repudia veementemente” ataque em jantar com Trump
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva vehemently condemned the attack that occurred during the White House Correspondents' Dinner on Saturday, April 25, 2026, in which an armed man attempted to breach security where President Donald Trump, his administration, media personnel, and guests were present. Lula expressed solidarity with Trump, First Lady Melania Trump, and all attendees, stating that political violence undermines democratic values. The U.S. Secret Service responded with gunfire, subdued the suspect—identified as 31-year-old California engineer Cole Allen, who was armed with firearms and knives—and confirmed that a Secret Service agent was shot but is recovering.

item.title: Pesquisas eleitorais: como está a disputa entre Lula e Flávio às vésperas da nova AtlasIntel
item.description: The 2026 presidential race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro is tightening, according to recent Datafolha and Genial/Quaest polls. Lula retains leads in some first-round scenarios but loses ground in second-round simulations due to government wear, economic dissatisfaction, and high rejection. Flávio Bolsonaro gains momentum by consolidating Bolsonarist support, effectively inheriting Jair Bolsonaro’s voters, and broadening his appeal with a more moderate agenda.

item.title: Lula repudia ataque a jantar com Trump: ‘Violência política é uma afronta aos valores democráticos’
item.description: President Lula (PT) expressed solidarity with U.S. President Donald Trump following a shooting incident at a White House Correspondents' Dinner in Washington. He condemned political violence as an affront to democratic values and called for global protection of democratic institutions. The incident occurred on Saturday night, April 25, 2026, when gunfire was heard, prompting Trump’s removal by Secret Service agents; a suspect was apprehended.

item.title: Lula reage a ataque contra Trump: 'violência política é afronta a valores democráticos'
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva condemned the armed attack on the White House Correspondents' Dinner, which was attended by U.S. President Donald Trump, calling political violence an affront to democratic values. He expressed solidarity with Trump and First Lady Melania on social media, stating that Brazil vehemently rejects the incident. Leaders from Pakistan, Venezuela, Mexico, Canada, Japan, Australia, India, and others also denounced the attack, stressing that political violence has no place in democracies, while U.S. figures like Nancy Pelosi and Gavin Newsom praised security forces and denounced the act as unacceptable.

item.title: Moro e Flávio Bolsonaro se unem em vídeo do PL
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro shared a promotional video on social media featuring himself, Flávio Bolsonaro (pre-candidate for President), and Deputy Filipe Barros (pre-candidate for Senate), marking their first joint appearance in PL campaign material in Paraná. The video invites viewers to join the party, highlighting the growing alliance between Moro and the Bolsonaro family ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: ‘Violência política é uma afronta aos valores democráticos’ diz Lula em repúdio a tentativa de ataque a Trump
item.description: President Lula strongly condemned the attempted attack on Donald Trump during a Washington dinner, stating that political violence affronts democratic values. He expressed solidarity with Trump, First Lady Melania Trump, and attendees, emphasizing that such acts threaten democratic institutions. The suspect, Cole Thomas Allen, was apprehended after opening fire, lightly injuring a Secret Service agent.

item.title: Lula se solidariza com Trump após ataque em jantar
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva expressed solidarity with former U.S. President Donald Trump following a shooting at a Washington dinner on Saturday night (April 25). Lula strongly condemned the attack, stating that political violence is an affront to democratic values that all must protect. The suspect, identified as Cole Tomas Allen, was arrested, and a Secret Service agent was injured.

item.title: A personagem de IA que viraliza com críticas ao governo Lula e ao STF
item.description: Dona Maria, an AI-generated avatar created with Google’s Gemini that portrays an elderly Black woman criticizing the Lula government and the STF, went viral on social media with a July 2025 video reaching 8.8 million views, using aggressive language to accuse Lula of silence amid U.S. tariffs on Brazilian exports. Though not a real person, her content sparked significant engagement and polarization, particularly among Bolsonaro supporters, prompting the PT, PV, and PCdoB to file a representation with the TSE in April 2025.

item.title: Lula manifesta solidariedade a Trump após tiros em jantar em Washington: 'Violência política afronta a democracia'
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva expressed solidarity with U.S. President Donald Trump and First Lady Melania Trump following a shooting at a Washington journalists' dinner on Saturday night. Lula condemned the attack as an affront to democratic values and stated that Brazil vehemently repudiates political violence. No one was injured, and the suspect was detained by U.S. authorities, who are investigating the incident as the act of a 'lone wolf'.

item.title: PT, PV e PCdoB pedem ao TSE suspensão de perfis de ‘Dona Maria’, personagem criada por IA
item.description: The PT, PV, and PCdoB parties filed a representation with the TSE requesting the immediate suspension of social media profiles under the name 'Dona Maria', an AI-generated character criticizing President Lula and the left. The parties argue that although the profile initially disclosed its AI nature, subsequent posts obscure this fact, presenting false and decontextualized information as if from a real person, constituting illegal political propaganda favoring Bolsonaro.

item.title: Presidência da República compra 94 fragmentadoras de papel, forno para pizza e máquina de salgados e doces
item.description: The Lula government is conducting a bidding process to purchase equipment for the Presidency of the Republic, including 94 paper shredders, a pizza oven, and a machine for snacks and sweets, intended for units such as the kitchen at the Palácio da Alvorada. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Criador do perfil “Dona Maria” nega ser bolsonarista
item.description: Daniel Cristiano dos Santos, the app driver behind the "Dona Maria" social media profile, denied being a supporter of Jair Bolsonaro. The account, which uses an AI-generated avatar of an elderly woman critical of President Lula, the Workers' Party, and left-wing figures, was featured by O Antagonista. The profile has gained attention for its conservative content and opposition to the current government.

item.title: Flávio tem 50,4% e Lula, 38,1% no 2º turno em SP, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Vox Brasil Pesquisas survey conducted from April 22–25, 2026 in São Paulo shows Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) would defeat President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in a hypothetical second-round runoff with 50.4% to 38.1%. In the first-round scenario, Flávio leads with 45.3%, followed by Lula at 34.5%. A majority of São Paulo voters (54.2%) disapprove of Lula’s administration.

item.title: Dívida pública avança sob Lula, que transfere bomba fiscal para a próxima gestão
item.description: Brazil's public debt rose to 79% of GDP in 2024, up from 72% in 2023, and is projected to reach 88% by 2029 under optimistic government forecasts that independent analysts deem unrealistic. Despite criticizing Bolsonaro's 'fiscal inheritance,' the Lula administration has expanded spending amid high interest rates and primary deficits, creating a 'fiscal bomb' to be passed to the next government. This rising debt increases country risk, diverts capital from productive investment to public bonds, and threatens long-term growth.

item.title: SP cria Plano de Segurança Viária para reduzir mortes no trânsito
item.description: The São Paulo state government instituted the State Road Safety Plan (PSV-SP) aiming to cut traffic deaths by half within five years, aligned with Vision Zero and Safe System principles. The plan establishes a Steering Committee, provides technical support to municipalities, enhances enforcement through technology and data management, and prioritizes vulnerable road users, especially motorcyclists, via initiatives like the 'Mão na Roda' program.

item.title: Ex-MJ lança candidatura à Câmara em evento com ministro da Fazenda
item.description: Marivaldo Pereira, former Secretary of Legislative Affairs at the Ministry of Justice and Public Security, launched his candidacy for the Federal District's seat in the Chamber of Deputies during an event in Brasília on Saturday, April 25, attended by Finance Minister Dario Durigan and other government and PT leaders. In his speech, he emphasized the importance of dialogue with Congress and the defense of agendas such as social justice, public security, and strengthening democratic institutions.

item.title: Corinthians x Vasco: reencontro com Diniz e tabu em jogo; veja odds
item.description: Corinthians hosts Vasco at Neo Química Arena in the 13th round of the Brasileirão, marking a reunion with Fernando Diniz, now Corinthians’ coach after leading Vasco in 2025-2026. Vasco aims to break its taboo of never having won at Neo Química Arena, where it has seven losses and two draws in nine meetings. Odds favor Corinthians (2.02), with a draw at 3.47 and a Vasco win at 3.52.

item.title: Festival Micarê 2026 promete agitar o feriado de 1º de maio em Brasília
item.description: The Micarê Festival 2026 will take place on May 1st and 2nd in Brasília, featuring electric trios and performances by artists such as Durval Lelys, Bell Marques, Xanddy, Tomate, Rafa and Pipo, along with Filhos do Brasil. The event offers differentiated experiences like Camarote and Atrás do Trio, with tickets starting at R$ 195 and an age restriction of 18 years.

item.title: Risco país volta para o menor patamar no governo Lula
item.description: Brazil's country risk (5-year CDS) closed at 122.9 points on April 24, 2026, matching the lowest level under President Lula’s government, recorded in February 2024. The decline signals improved investor confidence despite domestic fiscal and political uncertainties, occurring amid a global environment of increased risk appetite and dollar weakness. The indicator, which had peaked at 279.65 points in March 2023, has shown substantial recovery since then.

item.title: Governo critica taxa das blusinhas por causa da eleição, diz associação
item.description: Edmundo Lima, executive director of ABVTex, criticized the federal government for discussing the repeal of the 'blusinhas tax' during an election year, claiming it is motivated by image recovery rather than economic justification. He argued for maintaining the tax to ensure fair competition between domestic retailers and international platforms, warning that its removal could lead to store closures and the loss of millions of jobs.

item.title: Entre medidas sociais e de segurança, Lula ainda precisa vencer debate da corrupção
item.description: The Lula government plans to launch in May new social and security measures, including actions against femicide, crime, and the Desenrola 2 program for indebted individuals, aiming to reverse declining popularity. Despite these efforts, Lula still faces the central challenge of overcoming corruption perceptions that affect his image. The article notes these initiatives are part of a broader strategy to regain electoral support ahead of the 2026 political landscape.

item.title: Nunes Marques quer aperfeiçoar cerco a uso indevido de inteligência artificial nas campanhas
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, who will assume the presidency of the TSE in May, aims to strengthen controls against the improper use of AI in the 2026 electoral campaigns, focusing on combating AI-generated disinformation. He plans to set deadlines for big techs to submit compliance plans, meet with their representatives, maintain ongoing dialogue, unify disciplinary processes, and reinforce confidence in the electronic voting system to depoliticize the electoral environment.

item.title: PL avalia que Zema ‘radical’ perde força para ser vice de Flávio
item.description: PL leaders argue that Romeu Zema's radicalization, particularly his attacks on the STF and controversial remarks about the Northeast, weakens his viability as Flávio Bolsonaro's running mate, as the senator needs to appeal to centrist voters. The party plans to test alternative candidates in polls, including Tereza Cristina, Simone Marchetto, Clarissa Tércio, and Priscila Costa, to balance the ticket and improve Northeastern prospects.

item.title: Petistas torcem para que Trump declare apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: PT leaders hope Donald Trump will publicly endorse Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the 2026 Brazilian presidential election, believing it could boost Lula’s re-election chances by enabling the PT to frame Bolsonaro as a candidate who would surrender Brazilian sovereignty to the U.S. The strategy aims to exploit Trump’s endorsement to tie Bolsonaro to foreign interests, particularly given Trump’s damaged image due to tariffs, actions against Nicolás Maduro, and Iran tensions.

item.title: STF e a questão democrática
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court faces legitimate criticism over alleged conflicts of interest involving justices and their families, particularly tied to the Banco Master scandal, but institutional attacks on the Court in the context of coup attempts require collective defense. A proposed ethical code of conduct, championed by Court President Edson Fachin and drafted by Minister Cármen Lúcia, is seen as the best remedy to restore credibility, while generic or opportunistic critiques, such as those from Romeu Zema, are dismissed.

item.title: Arco-íris em Nuvens de Chumbo: a resistência da civilidade no século XXI
item.description: The text describes an alarming rise in hate speech, intolerance, and disinformation in Brazil and globally, including racism, antisemitism, homophobia, misogyny, xenophobia, and aporophobia, often linked to authoritarian and denialist movements attacking social rights, science, and democracy. Civilized values are eroding, with empathy replaced by hatred and dehumanization used as a political tactic, echoing patterns seen in the rise of Nazism.

item.title: Freada de arrumação
item.description: The dispute between candidate Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais, and Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes is opening space for an alternative candidacy to the polarization between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. While Lula seeks to unite the nation against coupism, Flávio attempts to approach the moderate right or center, leveraging Brazil’s historically conservative and centrist electorate, which has long defined election outcomes.
